insights.one_liner: A Veghel-based maker of baggage and parcel handling systems for top airports and logistics firms, owned by Toyota Industries.

culture.text: Nearly 10,000 employees, mostly engineers; Fontys and TU Eindhoven are its top schools.
It has 900 people in R&D who build its hardware and software in-house.
Current openings are two operations and supply chain internships in Veghel, one of which shows pay.

open.text: Vanderlande Industries B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current internships are open to non-Dutch speakers.

growth.text: Revenue is approaching €3 billion, and it serves the world's top 50 airports.
Its takeover of Siemens Logistics got clearance in Portugal, after Spain.

worth_knowing.text: Rival Beumer is suing EU regulators over the review of the Vanderlande-Siemens Logistics deal.
Its ultimate owner is Toyota Industries of Japan.
